rule: a_salmon > 0, the Northwest Coast's median absolute log10 error improves by at least 0.05, the rest of the world's median absolute log10 error and density rank not worse by more than 0.01, and the interior's median absolute log10 error not worse than without salmon. Then data/foraging_model.json takes (a_salmon, L) (the map: drawn rivers reaching a sea below 15 C annual, weighted by distance along them to the sea, scaled to HydroRIVERS' stream density) and the atlases' foraging is rebuilt.
